name: PHYSRISK — physical-risk green-Solow, differential capital destruction (FD-3D, harness reuse; minimal pair with JONES)
summary: Process: JONES's scale-free skeleton with ONE coupling swapped — the utility damage -delta logN(Y) is DELETED; instead temperature physically DESTROYS capital at sector-specific rates subtracted from the drifts: dK_j = K_j[phi_j(i_j) - Lambda_j(Y)]dt + sigma_j K_j dW_j, Lambda_j(Y) = gamma_j D(Y), gamma_d = 1.0 > gamma_g = 0.25 (dirty assets more exposed — the Fried physical-risk channel; Lambda_d(2C) ~ 0.9%/yr), D(Y) = lambda1 + lambda2 Y pre-damage and lambda1 + lambda2 Y + lambda3(l)(Y - yhat) post-damage. Same intensity emissions E(Z) = eta A_d(1-Z)K0, same intensity hazard K0 e^{s}/varrho, same damage-jump J_n(Y) and lambda3 grid, same full robustness (all h channels and jump g's), same production R&D technology. Consequences: dirty capital is DOUBLY penalized (it emits and gets destroyed), the Z-drift gains the self-decarbonizing term +Z(1-Z)(Lambda_d - Lambda_g) > 0, the shadow cost of Y multiplies growth rather than the utility level, and i_d acquires genuine high-(Y, Z) de-investment geometry the attractor lacks. Exact reduction V = logK + W(Z, Y, s) (sympy-verified on the full 4-state robust generator including both jumps). Role in the zoo: the MINIMAL PAIR — identical geometry class to JONES with only the damage channel differing, isolating whether the init map's damage channel selects the training basin. Corrections: shares JONES's harness fixes (s-grid [-6, 2], semi-implicit jump sinks, monotone cross-term splitting); its critique's Barles–Souganidis gap is closed by the same monotone splitting + Richardson gate; the mandatory Feynman–Kac level check is promoted to a zoo-wide gate.
solution_formulas: Reduced HJB = JONES's with the substitutions: phi_d -> phi_d - Lambda_d(Y) and phi_g -> phi_g - Lambda_g(Y) inside mu_K (coefficient of 1 - W_s) and mu_Z (coefficient of W_Z), and the -delta logN(Y) utility term dropped; jump terms, loadings, and diffusion block unchanged. FOCs are IDENTICAL in form to JONES (Lambda_j is additive in the drift, no i-derivative): delta/c = phi_d'(i_d)[1 - W_s - Z W_Z] = phi_g'(i_g)[1 - W_s + (1-Z)W_Z] = (psi0/2) i_r^{-1/2} e^{-s/2} W_s. Same 4-regime backward ladder, same grids (Z 61, Y 41, s 61 on [-6, 2]), same xi family {0.05, 0.1, 148.4}, same PIBYS scheme — implemented as per-economy drift/utility callbacks in the shared solvers/fd_reduced.py harness (JONES minus logN plus Lambda_j terms), so the marginal build is a coefficient swap plus verification. Verification adds the end-to-end Feynman–Kac Monte Carlo: simulate the full SDE + two-jump system under the FD policies from >= 20 seeds and confirm realized E[integral e^{-delta t} delta log C-tilde dt] = logK0 + W at the seeds within MC error — the LEVEL certificate for the whole regime chain.
lift_map: Identical structure to JONES: all four production states shared, s = logR - logK, v(x) = logK + W_reg(Z, Y, s; lambda3, xi) with trilinear (Z, Y, s) + linear lambda3 + linear logxi interpolation and the repo +/-logN transform convention; no clipping (grid covers the box image). Policies i_d, i_g, i_r = FD fields; i_r nontrivial via the e^{-s/2} W_s c form in both pre-tech regimes; post-tech 2-D, no i_r net. Distinct imprint relative to JONES despite the shared geometry class: i_d carries the de-investment region at high (Y, Z), W has growth-damage (drift-multiplied) Y-shaping instead of utility-level shaping, and the Z-drift self-decarbonization tilts W_Z.
plots: (1) 2x2 heatmaps over (Z, Y) at s = s0, xi = 0.1: W, i_d, i_g, i_r — displaying the high-Y i_d de-investment region against the i_g ridge. (2) Knowledge geometry: i_r and W_s over (s, Z) at Y = 1.1 with (s0, Z0) marked, side by side with the same JONES panels (the minimal-pair contrast figure). (3) Simulated transition paths from (880, 0.7, 1.1, 11.2): Z_t, Y_t, i_d, i_g, i_r and the destruction flow Lambda_d(Y_t) K_t^d, overlaid on the RUNA reference paths.
